text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/stream in us-west-2 > 5s (SLO p99=1.5s). Error rate rising, sockets failing intermittently. Paging oncall. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-latency

matt (oncall): on it. which AZ/cluster? any customer reports?

priya (sre): seeing concentrated errors on proxy fleet node-group `usw2-proxy-a`. tcp write timeouts and backlog spike. logs show repeated `write timeout after 30s` from the proxy to edge clients. KV cache hit-rate normal.

lia (infra): confirmed. LB healthy checks are green, but proxy worker threads are at 95% busy and socket send queues are growing. Looks like slow consumers + larger-than-usual chunk sizes.

matt (oncall): steps? can we evict slow clients + route traffic off that node group?

priya (sre): propose quick mitigation: 1) enable `evict-slow-consumers` on proxies in usw2, 2) set proxy `write_timeout`=15s temporarily, 3) shift 30% of traffic to dedicated-capacity pool in us-west-2. Doing 1+2 first.

lia (infra): running evict toggle now (ops API):
```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/proxy/config" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2","evict_slow":true}'
```
lia (infra): response: `{"status":"applied","targets":12}`

priya (sre): also lowering write_timeout via ssm (will roll config on proxy ASG):
```
redwoodctl config set proxy.write_timeout=15 --region us-west-2 --sync
```
priya (sre): applied. watch metrics for reconnect spikes.

devops-bot: :gear: Config change applied to ASG `usw2-proxy-a` (12 instances). Rolling restart started. CI: deploy-789

matt (oncall): routing 30% to dedicated-cap using traffic-split API now. command:
```
redwoodctl route split set /v1/stream --region us-west-2 --variant dedicated --weight 30
```
matt (oncall): split applied.

emily (cs): CS update: 7 customers opened support tickets about stalled streams; primary symptom = long pauses then reconnects. Preparing proactive outreach for impacted customers.

priya (sre): quick diagnostic log sample from proxy (tail):
```
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] proxy=usw2-proxy-a/7 level=warn msg="client write timeout after 30s" conn_id=12345 route=/v1/stream backlog=512
[2026-03-17T14:12:09Z] proxy=usw2-proxy-a/7 level=info msg="evicted slow client" conn_id=12345 reason=write_timeout
```
priya (sre): after evict toggle and write_timeout change p99 improved from ~5.2s to ~1.4s in 3 minutes. p95 stable.

lia (infra): observed an immediate drop in socket send queues and worker CPU down to 68%. reconnect spike ~1.2x but within normal.

matt (oncall): customer impact estimate: ~2% of streaming sessions affected for ~8 min window. CS to post a note on status page.

emily (cs): posting now: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/9220045678 - message drafted and sent to impacted customers list.

priya (sre): next actions before handoff to postmortem: collect heap/disk stats from proxies, capture tcpdump for 2 minutes on `usw2-proxy-a` for sample conn_ids, and record exact config versions. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

matt (oncall): agreed. assign postmortem to priya+lia. tagging product for customer impact analysis.

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation complete. p99 back under SLO for 10m. Incident marked as "mitigated - monitoring".

emily (cs): filed CS follow-ups and added note to support tickets.

priya (sre): creating postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-9220045678-postmortem - will include root cause, why slow consumers grew, and follow-up to tune chunk sizes and add adaptive drop for slow clients.

matt (oncall): handing off to priya for postmortem. I'll close the pager. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :lock: Incident state updated -> MITIGATED by matt (oncall).
